flashcard_questions.q: The central part of an atom, containing protons and neutrons, where almost all the atom’s mass is concentrated.
Negatively charged subatomic particles that orbit the nucleus in energy levels (shells).
Atoms of the same element that have the same number of protons but a different number of neutrons, giving them different mass numbers.

flashcard_questions.a: An unstable isotope that decays over time by emitting radiation from its nucleus.
Energy or particles released from the nucleus of an unstable atom during radioactive decay.
